typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblSLACPproductdetail_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		cusip as string,
		EffDate as timestamp,
		longDesc as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FACSEDSTIER2ProductDetail
FACSEDSTIER2ProductDetail sink(input(
		cusip as string,
		EffDate as string,
		longDesc as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cusip,
		EffDate,
		longDesc),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblSLACPproductdetail_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblSLACPproductdetail
